page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, this instance provides dedicated compute resources without simultaneous multithreading, ensuring consistent performance for compute-intensive tasks.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a high-capacity baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps, which supports high-throughput data transfers and low-latency communication between distributed nodes.

Given its high density of dedicated physical cores and substantial memory capacity, the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge offers a highly resource-dense profile for enterprise workloads. The lack of local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for workloads that rely heavily on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing. It is well-suited for large-scale enterprise applications, web serving, distributed caching, and general-purpose workloads requiring high network throughput and dedicated CPU execution.
